domain_rule.rule: A run is scoreable only if f_out <= 1e-12 for every reaction over every saved frame and cell, and no table is unresolved (evaluated from the reaction-validity audit directly, independent of 'sustained'; v1 O2). The domain is never widened to make a run scoreable; a domain change is a controlled model-domain change with its own evidence, version, HISTORY entry, pre-registration and rerun, and data seen before it cannot count as new evidence for it.

registration_inputs.principle: Registration inputs describe what the H-1 experiment WAS. They are measured, enter the solver through a mechanical rule fixed at lock, and are never fitted to any held-out observable. Their measurement uncertainty is propagated blind (before data) into the model-side uncertainty u_reg; there is no selectable set of registration hypotheses (contrast P5 layer 1, which existed only because P5's geometry and field were not published).

registration_inputs.u_reg_rule: PROPOSED: blind (before any held-out output is released to the physics track; under VP-17 HOLD_S1B before any Hall-on reading), each registration input is perturbed by +/- its audited standard uncertainty (RG-07a, required before PF-1) one at a time for every candidate x mandatory chemistry x condition (blind runs); u_reg is the root-sum-square of the half-differences per observable. condition_families.rule: Condition sets are fixed at LOCK-H1 as a finite, enumerated grid known before data (all lane-25 setpoints, incl. every knee-scan level and the knee-fallback midpoint), so that PF-1 can predict every condition before it is measured.

families.name: Phase 1 hall_only N2 sustainment knee scan (S2, down and up)
families.count: T-KNEE-LEVELS levels x 2 directions (lane 25 PROPOSED 5 levels; TBD at LOCK-1)
families.runnable: yes once RG-01, RG-02, RG-04..RG-06, RG-07a, RG-08, RG-10, RG-11 are met
families.direction_rule: PROPOSED (VP-19): the pinned 1-D solver starts every run from a fixed initial state and has no path memory, so it makes ONE prediction per level, compared with both the down and the up reading. If the measured sustainment class of a level differs between the two directions (hysteresis), that level is HYSTERETIC: it is not scored for C-SUST (as SUSTAINMENT_MIXED), C-ID and C-T are not scored at that level, and the hysteresis is reported as a non-gating diagnostic that a path-free model cannot test. It is neither FAIL_VALIDATION nor a pass. If both directions agree, each direction's reading is scored against the single prediction. Alternative for the owner: treat a HYSTERETIC mandatory level as a non-admissible target (candidate INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL).

modes.primary: VACUUM_VS_RAW_WITH_FACILITY_ADMISSIBILITY (PROPOSED, VP-03): vacuum-mode simulation (facility ingestion OFF) compared with RAW measured targets at base p_b. No ingestion correction is applied to the data (lane 25 section 8: no ingestion model rescues a class). A target is admissible only if the S5-measured background-pressure sensitivity, extrapolated linearly from base p_b to zero, shifts the observable by less than TH-FAC x its tolerance; otherwise TARGET_NOT_ADMISSIBLE_FACILITY.
modes.secondary: FACILITY (non-gating): ingestion ON at measured p_b, compared with raw targets; ingestion-model parameters are recorded assumptions and never fitted

C-ID.form: |I_d,sim - I_d,exp| <= tol_Id at every mandatory condition
C-ID.tolerance_form: PROPOSED (VP-02): tol_Id = I_d,exp x eps_Id, with eps_Id >= k x sqrt(u_exp,rel^2 + u_reg,rel^2)
C-ID.target_source: H-1 HW-0 readings, mean over the n blocks of the condition (new common-hardware experiment)
C-ID.tolerance_source: W4 audited uncertainty + blind u_reg + owner eps_Id

C-T.form: |T_1D x f_div,measured - T_exp| <= tol_T at every mandatory condition with an admissible thrust reading
C-T.tolerance_form: PROPOSED: tol_T = k x sqrt(u_T,exp^2 + (T_1D u_f_div)^2 + u_reg,T^2)
C-T.target_source: H-1 HW-0 thrust-stand readings (new common-hardware experiment)

C-SUST.form: (a) experiment SUSTAINED and model extinct (v1 O1 definition, mode-matched target = raw I_d) -> FAIL_VALIDATION / SUSTAINMENT; (b) experiment NOT_SUSTAINED and model sustained -> FAIL_VALIDATION / SUSTAINMENT_FALSE_POSITIVE (PROPOSED new reason, VP-08); (c) SUSTAINMENT_MIXED (or HYSTERETIC, F1 direction_rule) -> condition not scored for sustainment
C-SUST.model_sustained_definition: PROPOSED (VP-18), needed because case (b) has no measured sustained I_d to act as the v1 O1 I_d,target: the run is model-extinct iff v1 O1 holds with I_d,target replaced by I_d,ref, and model-sustained otherwise. I_d,ref is data-free and fixed by the grid: the time-mean PF-1 I_d of the SAME candidate x chemistry x configuration at the highest-flow level of the F1 scan (the scan starts at mdot_nom, lane 25). If the model is itself O1-extinct at that reference level (O1 applied with I_d,target = its own PF-1 mean over the first half of the simulated time), every level of that scan is model-extinct. For F2 points outside the scan, I_d,ref is the same F1 reference at the same V_d, or, for V_hi points, the PF-1 I_d at OP3H. Alternative for the owner: a fixed absolute threshold on I_d in A, set at LOCK-H1 before data.
C-SUST.target_source: H-1 HW-0 per-condition sustainment class (lane 25 section 9) (new common-hardware experiment)

C-OSC.form: PROPOSED: class match QUIET / OSCILLATORY using one pre-registered relative-amplitude threshold applied identically to measured and simulated I_d(t) (threshold PROPOSED - owner value, VP-05); peak-frequency residual reported
C-OSC.target_source: H-1 HW-0 I_d traces (new common-hardware experiment)

C-DIAG.form: signed residuals and orderings reported per condition; never admit or reject

condition_match.rule: PF-1 predictions are scored against a reading only if its measured mdot, V_d and coil currents are within TH-COND of the PF-1 setpoint. Otherwise the custodian releases an INPUT-ONLY extract (measured conditions, no outputs); the physics track reruns mechanically with identical settings; PF-2 is hash-frozen before any output of those readings is released. PF-2 introduces no new modelling choice.
condition_match.TH-COND: TBD_FROM_INSTRUMENTATION (W1 control tolerance, W4 flow/voltage/current uncertainty)

run_status.collapse_outside_domain: a run that collapses AND crosses the chemistry validity boundary is OUT_OF_DOMAIN, not a SUSTAINMENT falsification (v1 O2)

target_status.note: measurement-side admissibility, evaluated before the run status and independent of the model
values: TARGET_NOT_ADMISSIBLE_CONDITION_MISMATCH (only if PF-2 cannot be produced)
target_status.effect: a non-admissible target is not scored; if it belongs to a mandatory condition, the affected candidate verdict cannot be PROMOTABLE through that condition (INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL)

run_status.no_rerun_rule: NUMERICAL_FAILURE runs are not rerun with changed numerics. Only an infrastructure crash may be rerun, with byte-identical inputs, logged in the ledger.

verdict_logic.per_candidate_and_chemistry_set: vacuum primary mode, 4 mandatory chemistry configs x every mandatory condition (F1 + F2, and F3/F6 if the owner makes them mandatory)

candidate.PROMOTABLE: every run in the mandatory set is PASS on every gating criterion with admissible targets
candidate.FAIL_VALIDATION: at least one run in the mandatory set is FAIL_VALIDATION (a genuine validation failure; recorded with reasons)
candidate.INCONCLUSIVE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: no FAIL_VALIDATION, but at least one mandatory run is OUT_OF_DOMAIN or NUMERICAL_FAILURE, or a mandatory target is not admissible; the candidate stays a screening hypothesis and is NOT rejected

verdict_logic.global_registration: there is one nominal registration per configuration (no member selection), so no 'exists a member' quantifier appears; this is stricter than v1 D5 by construction
verdict_logic.after_PROMOTABLE: PROMOTABLE never admits. Admission additionally needs every staged sensitivity (and triggered escalation) scored and dispositioned by the owner, and an admission record per admission_record_schema_v1 (the O4 gate). Screening candidates never produce design Hall maps.
verdict_logic.outcome_permanence: the scored outcome of this campaign, like v1, is never rewritten; any later change is a new, separately pre-registered campaign

roles.OWNER: decides VP-*, approves LOCK-H1/LOCK-H2, designates the custodian
roles.DATA_CUSTODIAN: owner-designated, not a physics-track modeller; holds raw readings; performs releases listed below; keeps the release log
roles.EXPERIMENT_TEAM: operates H-1; sees all data (needed to run the experiment)
roles.ARCHITECTURE_TRACK: receives R_arch, T, P_bus, sustainment classes per lane 25 (needed for stops); must not pass held-out outputs to the physics track
roles.PHYSICS_TRACK: generates predictions; sees registration inputs only, until the scoring release

sequence: K0: this DRAFT -> owner decisions VP-01..VP-19 -> successor draft

K1: LOCK-H1 (sha256 of criteria, rules, candidate set, chemistry configs, numerics, prediction and scoring scripts, condition grid): before the custodian releases any S1a registration input to the physics track, and therefore before any Hall-on reading of H-1
K2: S1a (no plasma) -> custodian releases registration inputs (geometry, B(z) at coil currents, calibrated feed setpoints) to the physics track

K3: physics track runs the blind prediction set PF-1 (9 candidates x mandatory chemistry x full condition grid, incl. u_reg perturbation runs and staged sensitivities) and hash-freezes it (sha256 recorded in the trigger ledger). Freeze point = owner decision VP-17: PROPOSED RELEASE_GATED = PF-1 frozen before the custodian releases any held-out output to the physics track (at the latest K6); the hardware schedule is not held and blinding rests on custody (roles, leak_rule). Alternative HOLD_S1B = PF-1 frozen BEFORE the first Hall-on reading (S1b); S1b waits for PF-1. Under either option: if PF-1 is not frozen at the freeze point, the held-out release (and so scoring) waits; no condition is dropped or added because PF-1 is late; under HOLD_S1B the owner may instead switch the whole campaign to RELEASE_GATED by a dated addendum recorded before S1b, never per condition and never after any Hall-on reading
K4: S1b -> custodian releases dispersion statistics only -> LOCK-H2 adds the audited uncertainty values through the LOCK-H1 formulas without discretion
K5: S2..S6 run; condition-mismatched readings -> input-only extract -> PF-2 frozen before any output release
K6: raw dataset frozen (sha256) at campaign end -> custodian releases held-out outputs to the frozen scoring script -> score once -> mechanical decision file -> owner
custody_and_blinding.leak_rule: If a held-out output reaches the physics track before K6, the custodian records it; predictions frozen before the leak remain valid; any prediction frozen after it for the leaked condition is flagged OUTPUTS_SEEN and cannot support PROMOTABLE for that condition.
custody_and_blinding.pf1_freeze_rule: VP-17 (see K3). Under RELEASE_GATED a Hall-on reading exists before PF-1 is frozen, so blinding depends entirely on custody: any held-out output that reaches the physics track before PF-1 is frozen triggers the leak_rule (OUTPUTS_SEEN for the affected conditions). Neither option lets a held-out output be used to select, tune or rerun a prediction.
custody_and_blinding.hash_lock: no score-bearing run and no PF-1 run before LOCK-H1; any change after LOCK-H1 is a new dated addendum, never an edit (as prereg/p5_n2_prereg_lock_v1.json)

forecast_risk.chemistry_domain: In P5-N2 v1, 66 % of run-readings were OUT_OF_DOMAIN (chemistry T_e > 30 eV; CLAUDE.md gate 3). If H-1 discharges reach similar electron temperatures, every candidate may again be INCONCLUSIVE regardless of data. A data-free blind state envelope run before LOCK-H1 on the W3 design geometry and design (computed) B(z), not on released S1a inputs (not PF-1, not score-bearing), reveals this before any data exist.
forecast_risk.legitimate_response: PROPOSED (VP-09): the owner may, BEFORE LOCK-H1 and without any data, add held-out conditions chosen from the blind state envelope of the candidates (e.g. conditions where the pre-data blind runs stay inside the domain). Choosing conditions from data-free model output is experimental design, not tuning. Relaxing f_out or the 45 eV cap is not a legitimate response.
